title: Positive sentiment
prompt:
Classify sentiment of "The setup was easy and everything works beautifully." Use positive,negative,neutral. Return sentiment. Return only valid JSON with exactly these fields: sentiment. Numeric values must be JSON numbers; boolean values must be JSON booleans; absent values null. No extra fields.

Write that JSON, and nothing else, to answer.json in the current directory.
acceptance: answer.json equals the gold answer under Abdul's equality rule
